edits.headline: Pope Leo XIV has peaceful night in hospital after surgery
edits.subheadline: The Vatican said the pope's lung surgery had been successfully completed, Gulf News reported.
editorialBody: Pope Leo XIV had a peaceful night in hospital following surgery, the Vatican said, ABC News reported. The Vatican said the lung surgery had been successfully completed, according to Gulf News.
In Albania, a fire broke out at the Education Ministry as student protests entered a third day, Al Jazeera reported.

In India, Delhi Police detained Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke at Delhi airport with party leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka, the Deccan Herald reported. Rahul Gandhi criticised the arrest of CJP leaders over a protest at Jantar Mantar, Kerala Kaumudi reported.
In Nepal, at least five people were missing after flash floods swept away houses, Al Jazeera reported on 11 October.
